question: Which bounded dark translation, if any, preserves selected CLR-01 F2 Monochrome + Intruder across co-equal Light/Dark while keeping Stage authority, semantic parity and sparse accent discipline intact?

candidate_intent.D1: Preserve the strongest violet-neutral continuity with the selected Light family.
candidate_intent.D2: Test a more neutral graphite translation while retaining violet structure and the same teal intruder role.
candidate_intent.D3: Test a slightly warmer aubergine-dark translation without borrowing F1's split-temperature logic.

frozen_scaffold: Exact accepted Production Home / Resume architecture
Identical content, state and hierarchy across Light/Dark candidates
mechanical_floors: Normal text contrast >= 4.5:1 on its role surface.
Required boundary/state reinforcement contrast >= 3:1 where it carries visible structure.
320 forced-colors preserves comprehension and focus/selection distinction.
320 at 200% text and text-spacing stress remains readable without semantic loss.
semantic_floors: Light and Dark communicate identical Product meaning and control/state availability.
Stage remains dark and visually dominant in both themes.
Focus remains structurally independent from selection.
Current/historical, provisional/effective and creator/Character distinctions remain non-color-dependent.
Teal intruder remains scarce; decorative spread is a failure.
visual_falsification: Reject a candidate that reads as generic violet/teal creative software more strongly than as the selected F2 mechanism.
Reject a candidate whose shell competes emotionally with the Stage.
Reject a candidate that loses F2 family continuity with the frozen Light reference.
Reject a candidate that uses darkness to imply unavailable/disabled/historical state absent from the Light version.
execution_law: Freeze candidate values before visual exposure.
No candidate retune after first complete render; mechanical repairs may only restore the frozen method without changing role colors.
Zero survivors is valid and returns to a successor-method decision rather than evidence-aware rescue.
A survivor remains a Phase-3 translation reference only until a later production-token gate.
next_gate: Materialize the selected Light F2 reference plus D1/D2/D3 on the exact Home scaffold, run the full mechanical/accessibility matrix, freeze Design Sol's visual view, then request Director adjudication only among mechanically surviving dark translations.
